# Security

**English** | [Русский](#безопасность)

## Reporting a problem

If you find a security problem (for example a way for a server's players to harm other players' computers, or a way out
of the Space Station 14 client sandbox), please **do not open a public issue**.

Use GitHub's private reporting instead: [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/Ehab-0/ss12/security/advisories/new).
Say what you did, what you saw, and which version (`installer/version.txt` or the release number).

This is a small fan project run by volunteers. We will answer as soon as we can and will credit you if you want.

## What the installer does and does not do

The installer only reads and writes files in the folder you give it and never connects to the internet. The 3D game runs
inside the normal Space Station 14 client sandbox. Problems in Space Station 14 itself or in RobustToolbox belong to those
projects: report them to the [Space Wizards](https://github.com/space-wizards).

---

## Безопасность

Если вы нашли проблему безопасности (например, способ навредить компьютерам других игроков или выйти за пределы песочницы
клиента Space Station 14), **не создавайте публичный issue**.

Напишите приватно: [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/Ehab-0/ss12/security/advisories/new). Опишите, что вы
делали, что увидели и какая версия (`installer/version.txt` или номер релиза).

Проблемы самой Space Station 14 или RobustToolbox относятся к тем проектам: сообщайте о них
[Space Wizards](https://github.com/space-wizards).
